sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Kings of the Rooftops is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Oh, howdy. Help an old soldier out, will you? Those damn snipers are shooting my couriers like rabbits in an open field. Sitting on the rooftops and blasting non-stop. Take them out and I'll make it worth your while."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 8 snipers on the rooftops on Streets of Tarkov

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Toolset
- 1× SV-98 7.62x54R bolt-action sniper rifle
- Unlocks purchase of SV-98 7.62x54R bolt-action sniper rifle at Prapor LL2
"Good shit, warrior, now that's some proper shooting!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill 8 sniper Scavs on Streets of Tarkov.
